Over the past five months, he experienced a depressive episode characterized by persistent feelings of emptiness, anhedonia, and marked loss of motivation, with notable psychomotor slowing evident in reduced gait speed and delayed initiation of movement. During this time, his speech was notably rapid and difficult for others to interrupt, accompanied by a subjective sense of racing thoughts and disorganized cognition. He demonstrated inflated self-esteem with beliefs of possessing unique insight into global architectural design, along with increased sexual drive and engagement in risky romantic behaviors. No functional impairment was observed during this phase. There is no evidence of psychotic features or manic severity requiring hospitalization.
